snippet.title: Knights of Fiona -- Japanese Cast Reveal
snippet.description:
An action-packed VR RPG you can play alone or with friends. Set in the land of "Gallia," you play as a knight who has just arrived in the city. Alongside your companion Fiona—who refuses to ever give up—you must stand against the crisis threatening the realm.

◤ Crowdfunding Now Live ◢

Support us on Kickstarter: https://bit.ly/KoFKickstarter
Support us on Campfire: https://camp-fire.jp/projects/877523

Bringing the "Ultimate VR Experience" from Japan to the world.

VR Multiplayer RPG Knights of Fiona Deploy with up to 3-player co-op!

#KnightsOfFiona #VR #jrpg
